en: Dependent on a mundane state, a supramundane state does not arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a supramundane state, a non-supramundane state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a supramundane state, a non-worldly state arises by way of root condition. (Dependent on a supramundane state, a non-worldly...)
And supramundane states do not arise with respect to both mundane and supramundane states by way of the root condition.
Dependent on both mundane and supramundane states, a supramundane state does not arise by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are five in the case of the root condition, two in the case of the object condition ... pe ... five in the case of the non-disappearance condition. (In all cases, there are five.)
